name: FORGE testing dataset
purpose: Repeatable testing of FORGE ingestion, multimodal retrieval, image segmentation, and grounded answering. This is not a production corpus.
redistribution: JA-Business-Doc-RQ-Bench is Apache-2.0. The Screw Dataset is CC-BY-4.0; attribute shrish23 and link to the Hugging Face source.

ja_business_doc_rq_bench.ground_truth: The source metadata includes one question, expected answer, answer type, and reasoning-step count for each selected image.
ja_business_doc_rq_bench.license: Apache-2.0 per source README; retain source attribution.

selection.method: Five lowest-numbered image IDs per class

screw_dataset.ground_truth: One paired PNG segmentation mask for each of the 30 screw images across six classes.
screw_dataset.license: CC-BY-4.0 per dataset.yaml; attribute shrish23 and retain source link.
